features.name: Tactical Wit
features.desc: You add your Intelligence modifier to your Initiative.

features.name: Arcane Deflection
features.desc: As a Reaction when you make a saving throw or are targeted by an attack, you gain +2 to AC or +4 to saving throws until the end of the turn (you can't cast spells this turn).

features.name: Power Surge
features.desc: You store surges of power (max = Int modifier): you expend one to add damage equal to half your Wizard level to one spell.

features.name: Durable Magic
features.desc: While you are concentrating on a spell, you gain +2 to AC and saving throws.

features.name: Deflecting Shroud
features.desc: After you use Arcane Deflection, you deal Force damage to a creature within 10 feet.
